name: Grande Poste d'Alger
subtitle: Central post office building completed in 1913 in the Neo-Moorish architectural style by Jules Voinot and Marius Toudoire.

parts.text: The central post office building of Algiers, standing at the junction of major city boulevards. Built between 1910 and 1913 by architects Jules Voinot and Marius Toudoire in the Neo-Moorish style, it combines monumental white arches, minaret-inspired clock towers and intricate stucco work, serving as a defining urban and civic landmark of central Algiers.

gaps: Primary municipal archive documents on construction tenders have not been retrieved.
